name: Abacum.ai
description: Ask your live Abacum data anything, right inside Claude. Pull actuals, plans and forecasts, run variance analysis by any dimension, spot the trend, then turn the numbers into commentary, memos and board-ready output — all without switching tools. Answers stay fast and accurate even on your largest, most detailed financial models, and only the data you ask for ever enters the conversation. Every request uses your own Abacum login and respects the permissions and access controls you already have. Built for finance teams and the business partners who depend on them, from month-end close to Monday's board meeting.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Abacum.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Abacum.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.abacum.ai/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Abacum.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Abacum.ai provides these MCP tools: abacum_describe_data, abacum_execute_sql, abacum_get_models, abacum_get_scenarios, abacum_get_space_table, abacum_get_variables, abacum_get_variance_analysis, abacum_list_space_tables, abacum_list_spaces, abacum_list_tables, and abacum_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Abacum.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Abacum.ai in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Abacum.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Abacum.ai is developed by Abacum. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
